# Coupling fields

*Generated by Claude.*

Every field WW3, MOM6 and CICE import, split into required and optional, with what the MESAWAVE setup provides and what a standard CESM configuration supplies. Line links go to the cap at the version in `CESM_crocodash`. Scalar (grid-size) fields are left out. Hover over any variable name for its full name and units.

**Required:** **mandatory** means the model stops if nothing supplies the field. **optional** means
the model drops it and runs without it. Optional fields can still matter: WW3 with no winds grows
no waves, and with no ice component it runs ice-free ([609–614](ww3:L609-L614)). CMEPS
(`esmFldsExchange_cesm_mod.F90`) decides what connects.

**Prefixes:** `Sa_`, `Faxa_` atmosphere · `So_`, `Fioo_` ocean · `Si_`, `Fioi_` ice · `Sw_` wave ·
`Foxx_`, `Sf_` merged by CMEPS.

**MESAWAVE:** {bdg-success}`yes` · {bdg-warning}`stand-in` (see
[compromises](mesaclip_cesm_modes.md#not-done-and-compromises)) · {bdg-info}`computed` by CMEPS from
MESACLIP fields · {bdg-danger-line}`not supplied` by MESAWAVE today, with a candidate variable where one exists · {bdg-secondary}`other` source. The MESAWAVE setup uses DATM%MESACLIP (6-hourly atmosphere), DOCN%MESACLIP (daily ocean), and DICE%MESACLIP (daily ice fraction). Ice and ocean
names were checked in HIST member 010's daily files only.

## WW3

### Required

| Import | Meaning | MESAWAVE | Line |
|---|---|---|---|
| `So_bldepth` | Ocean boundary-layer depth | {bdg-danger-line}`not supplied` | [208–210](ww3:L208-L210) |

```{note}
`So_bldepth`: DOCN sends 1e30 to satisfy the mandatory import; WW3 runs but Langmuir outputs (`Sw_lamult`, `Sw_hstokes`) receive fill. These outputs require `LMPN=T` in WW3's namelist, which is off by default and is not set in the Alaska case.
```

### Optional

| Import | Meaning | MESAWAVE | Standard source | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `So_t` | SST | {bdg-success}`yes` `SST`, °C → K | DOCN or MOM6 | [204](ww3:L204) |
| `So_u`, `So_v` | Surface current | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `U1_1`, `V1_1` × 0.01 | DOCN or MOM6 | [202–203](ww3:L202-L203) |
| `Sa_tbot` | Air temperature | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `TREFHT` | DATM | [205](ww3:L205) |
| `Sa_u10m`, `Sa_v10m` | 10 m wind | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `UBOT`, `VBOT` | DATM | [206–207](ww3:L206-L207) |
| `Si_ifrac` | Ice fraction | {bdg-success}`yes` `aice_d` ÷ 100 from DICE%MESACLIP | CICE or DICE | [200](ww3:L200) |
| `Si_thick` | Ice thickness | {bdg-danger-line}`not supplied` could use `hi_d` ÷ (`aice_d`/100) | CICE | [201](ww3:L201) |
| `Si_floediam` | Floe diameter | {bdg-danger-line}`not supplied` | CICE | [211–213](ww3:L211-L213) |

## CICE

CICE requires `Sa_pbot` or `Sa_ptem` + `Sa_dens`; it aborts if neither is present ([488–499](cice:L488-L499)). MESACLIP DATM provides both.

### Required

| Import | Meaning | MESAWAVE | Line |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Sa_pbot` | Lowest-level pressure | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `PS` | [175](cice:L175) |
| `Sa_ptem`, `Sa_dens` | Potential temperature, density | {bdg-info}`computed` in DATM | [183–184](cice:L183-L184) |

### Optional

| Import | Meaning | MESAWAVE | Standard source | Line |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Sa_z`, `Sa_u`, `Sa_v` | Lowest-level height, wind | {bdg-success}`yes` `ZBOT`, `UBOT`, `VBOT` | DATM | [170–172](cice:L170-L172) |
| `Faxa_lwdn` | Downward longwave | {bdg-success}`yes` `FLDS` | DATM | [180](cice:L180) |
| `Faxa_rain`, `Faxa_snow` | Rain, snow | {bdg-success}`yes` `PRECT`, `PRECC`, `PRECSC`, `PRECSL` | DATM | [181–182](cice:L181-L182) |
| `Sa_shum`, `Sa_tbot` | Humidity, air temperature | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `QREFHT`, `TREFHT` | DATM | [173–174](cice:L173-L174) |
| `Faxa_swvdr`, `Faxa_swvdf`, `Faxa_swndr`, `Faxa_swndf` | Downward shortwave, 4 bands | {bdg-warning}`stand-in` `SOLSD`, `SOLLD`, `FSDS` | DATM | [176–179](cice:L176-L179) |
| `So_t`, `So_s` | SST, SSS | `SST` {bdg-success}`yes`, `So_s` {bdg-danger-line}`not supplied` | DOCN or MOM6 | [163–164](cice:L163-L164) |
